name: Redoubt Prime

stars.name: Redoubt
stars.notes: Sol-like yellow dwarf with a stable, well-behaved habitable zone; the reason the Coalition built its fortress here.

planets.name: Cinderwatch
planets.notes: Sulfur-rich furnace world worked by teleoperated mining rigs for industrial reagents.

planets.name: Bastion
planets.notes: Fortress capital of the Reach: planetary defense grids, buried command bunkers, and cities built to survive a siege.

planets.name: Longwatch
planets.notes: Agri-colony of floating kelp farms and arcology isles that feeds the garrisons of Bastion.

planets.name: Gravestone
planets.notes: Fleet cemetery world; hulks of the honored dead are grounded in rows visible from orbit.

planets.name: Colossus
planets.notes: Fuel refining giant whose skimming platforms supply the entire Third Fleet.

planets.name: Pale Sentinel
planets.notes: Carries unmanned early-warning arrays watching the approach corridors day and night.

planets.name: Far Drum
planets.notes: Outermost world, mined for volatiles; its cometary harvests top off departing warships' tanks.

anomalies.name: The Standing Wave
anomalies.notes: A permanent gravitational bulge that wrecks any direct approach vector; attackers must funnel through the single stable Gate Approach — straight past the defense grids.

asteroid_belts.name: Shrapnel Belt
asteroid_belts.notes: Debris field from the Battle of the Shrapnel Belt; salvagers work it under Navy escort because unescorted hulls have a way of disappearing.

stations.name: High Command Spire
stations.notes: Headquarters of the Coalition Third Fleet; more flag officers pass through its docks than any station in four sectors.

stations.name: Anchorpoint Yard
stations.notes: Shipbreaking and refit yard carved into battle debris; half its raw material is the enemy fleet it defeated.

stations.name: Longwatch Terminal
stations.notes: Civilian freight port handling food exports; every hull is inspected twice, once coming and once going.

faction_control.notes: Solidly Coalition-held and militarized to a degree that borders on paranoia; civilian traffic is tolerated, watched, and channeled.

history: Surveyed early in the first expansion wave and passed over as ordinary until strategic planners noticed the Standing Wave made it nearly assault-proof.
The Battle of the Shrapnel Belt broke the last invasion fleet against the Gate Approach funnel; the debris never left orbit.
Now the seat of Coalition High Command in the Reach, the system grows more fortified each year, and its people have stopped asking who the walls are for.
description: A warm yellow sun shines over seven ordered worlds, but everything about Redoubt Prime is arranged like a fist: fortress world at the second orbit, farm ocean at the third, fuel giant and sensor pickets ringing the outside. The Standing Wave closes the back door, leaving one road in.

This is where the Coalition Third Fleet lives. High Command Spire directs operations across four sectors, Anchorpoint Yard turns old wars into new ships, and heavy traffic flows through the Gate Approach under the eyes of the defense grid. Civilian spacers call the place 'the polite gun' — everything is permitted, nothing is unobserved.

Yet the fortress has its unease. The Shrapnel Belt still swallows salvage crews despite escorts, Gravestone's grounded hulks show wear patterns no battle accounts explain, and High Command has begun quietly expanding bunkers downward rather than up. Whoever they expect next, the Coalition does not believe the last war was the last.
